exceptions.reason: Pinned upstream Tailwind CSS is compiler input for opaque sandbox documents only, never a host stylesheet or control skin. build-tailwind.mjs reproduces this exact generated file; host theme values still come from computed CSS variables.
Markdown document typography, syntax and proposal diff presentation are content, not shadcn controls. Editor toolbars and menus are not exempt.
The browser PDF renderer owns the embedded document's appearance. The pane's toolbar and frame are not exempt.
Layout metrics such as gaps, widths, grid tracks and 44px touch targets arrange content and remain permitted. They cannot set colour, font, shadow, radius, border width or motion.

A thread tells agents from people by shape: an agent is a rounded square with a glyph, a person is a circle with an initial. The shape is meaning, not skin; the colour stays on theme tokens (info-soft). Only SharedChat's member avatar may do this.
The optional registry theme defines defaults; the fictional browser fixture defines a host theme. Only these theme definitions may contain visual literals.

A drawing's own white page and the native renderers' output (Excalidraw, and the vendored diagrams.net viewer run only inside the drawing viewer's opaque sandbox frame) are document content drawn as the tool draws it, never host chrome or a control skin. D-1398.

A nav state dot is a circle by meaning (D-2028): a round 8px mark that is told apart from a count or a button. The shape is not skin; the colour stays on the tone tokens (info, success, warning, destructive). Only the app-shell nav dot and the agent-bar history dot may do this.

A link inside a sentence is text, not a control box: a plain anchor without padding or height breaks across lines like the text around it (D-1715, D-1696). Only StatusNarrative's link parts may do this, and only for the focus ring radius (rounded-sm).

The composer controller's cells are 16 px high and 28 to 32 px wide, smaller than any kit Button size, so they are plain buttons with a hover fill (no chip or circle), a hidden 44 px hit area and the notch's pill shape. Only the controller's ControllerCell may do this.

The window stack orders its windows by 1 + their position inside the isolated window layer (z-composer): a dynamic order of siblings in one box, not a layer, so it has no --z-* name. A fixed local index is a token (--z-above, --z-drop).

The explore composer's toggle is the approved mockup's slim vertical tab, 30 by 76 px, narrower than any kit Button size and with a vertical label, so it is a plain button with the theme colours, like the controller notch.

A text field is 16px on a touch screen: below that iOS Safari zooms the page when the field takes focus. The size is behaviour, not skin, so it stays text-base. Only the composer textarea and the inline question input may do this.

text-base, text-xl and text-2xl (16, 20 and 24px) on titles and sentences of the sign-in, expert-overview, agent-question and account blocks. The default theme declares no such step in --text-body/--text-title/--text-chat (13, 14, 15px), so a rename to a declared token would change the size. Listed under needs a look in the pull request that added the scan; each goes when its block gets a declared step.
